name: html-nested-style-rule-attribute-selector-projection
description: A nested style rule gated by source attributes projects like its flat equivalent, while ungated nested rules keep their authored nesting. Selector analysis only read top-level rules, so a nested rule gated by source attributes (`.menu{&[data-mode=v]{&[layout=one] .item{...}}}`) was emitted verbatim: lowering dropped the attributes and moved the class it selected, and the vertical-menu padding and item separators stopped applying.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral fixture: site builders ship stylesheets compiled with native CSS nesting.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
